$comment: The one record of which Sparkle Kingfisher embeds. `desktop/scripts/fetch-sparkle.mjs` downloads this archive, refuses any other bytes, and unpacks it to desktop/vendor/Sparkle; `publicKey` is the EdDSA key every update must be signed with, and goes into Info.plist as SUPublicEDKey. The private half lives in the maintainer's login keychain (Sparkle's generate_keys, account `kingfisher`) — never in this repository.
